title: Currency
description: Currency information including ISO codes, exchange rates, symbols, and countries of use. Used for currency conversion, international payments, and financial applications.

id.description: Unique identifier for the currency record

code.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY)

name.description: Full name of the currency (e.g., US Dollar, Euro, British Pound)

exchange_rate.description: Current exchange rate relative to USD (1 unit of this currency = X USD)

countries.description: Array of country names that use this currency as their official currency

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the exchange rate was last updated
